_comment: Shared asset budget data (TECH_PLAN §3.10-3.12, §8.9, §8.10). Read by the Unity import rules (LongShadow.Core.Editor.ImportBudgetsFile -> TextureBudgets/ModelRules) and by Tools/build/validate_assets.py, so both use the same lists. Owner: WP00 (later WP11). After an edit run LongShadow/Import/Reapply Rules (All Game Assets) in the editor. Folder names are the asset folders below Art/Textures/<Kind>/ or Art/Models/<Kind>/ (case-insensitive).

texture._comment: Code-side lists for the §8.9 rows a manifest 'budget' text cannot express. The manifest budget of the folder wins where it states a size, except folder_caps (explicit overrides, logged in Docs/DECISIONS.md).

model._comment: Static props that are lightmapped (D8: big props) get generated lightmap UVs; any file whose name has the token _LM does too.

class_tris._comment: LOD0 triangle caps per class (§8.9) used when the manifest budget of the folder gives no number.

audio._comment: Source checks (§8.9) and the WebGL download estimate. Unity 6000.6 encodes every clip as AAC at 44.1 kHz for WebGL (sample-rate overrides and WebGL platform overrides are not applied; measured 2026-10-16), so the estimate uses 44.1 kHz and the import quality. aac_kbps_per_channel is an assumption until WP11 measures the build report.

download._comment: Download estimate (§8.9 measured basis: a Crunch q50 BC+N+M set ~0.87 MB at 1024 incl. mips) and the §8.10 budget lines in MB. Everything in Assets/_Game that is not editor-only is counted, so the total is an upper bound until WP11's BudgetReport reads the real build.
